summary: Frontend-only verification of the mobile CTA shortening, duplicate-CTA de-duplication, Pricing CTA rename, and Hero mobile static-image + pink radial glow changes. All 8 requested checks passed. No console errors. No regressions in click/scroll/nav behavior.
critical_code_review_comments: shortCta() fallback for 'Talk to Rekha'/'Join the Community' returns 'Ask Me' via EXACT map only — regex fallback would hit 'Ask Me' too, so fine. Consider adding unit tests for ctaLabel.js for future safety.

SeoIntro duplicate-detection compares page.cta === heroCtaResolved (raw strings). If a page defines a different cta but the same short-label maps to the same one-word (e.g. both regex to 'Enquiry'), mobile still could show identical one-word labels. Not observed on sampled pages, but worth guarding by comparing shortCta() of both.
